title: How do you launch holiday direct mail fast?
summary: It’s not too late to send holiday direct mail. Here’s how to move from idea to mailbox fast with templates, connected data, a print network, and smart routing.
body_markdown:
The holiday calendar still has room for direct mail. If you want to maximize the impact of your campaigns, it’s worth adding a postcard or selfmailer to your marketing mix. According to Lob’s[State of Direct Mail Consumer Insights 2026](https://www.lob.com/state-of-direct-mail/consumer-insights/2026-report) report, 41% of consumers say they’re more likely to engage when they receive both mail and digital touchpoints together.


Campaigns that drop in late November can reach homes in early to mid-December, in time for your final holiday push. Here’s how to get up and running fast.


## Use templates to skip the blank page


Ready-made[holiday templates](https://www.lob.com/template-gallery/self-mailers) give you a head start. Lob’s Template Gallery includes seasonal pieces for financial services, healthcare, real estate, and retail, from budgeting letters to Cyber Monday mailers. Swap in your branding, offer, and copy, then add personalization and a QR code so recipients can act right away.


If your team designs in Figma or InDesign, connectors turn your design into a dynamic template in a few clicks. Marketers can mark personalized fields and preview with real data without waiting on a developer.


## Let a print network handle production


A single print vendor puts your campaign in that vendor’s queue. Paper shortages, equipment issues, and weather delays at one facility become your delays.


Lob’s Print Delivery Network gives you a different path. The network matches jobs to printers close to your recipients, so production starts sooner and mail travels fewer miles. If one facility hits a delay, production routes to another. That flexibility matters in November and December, when everyone sends at once.


## Route mail to arrive on time


Where mail enters the USPS network shapes how long delivery takes. Mail that enters closer to its final destination crosses fewer zones and arrives sooner. Lob’s Postal IQ routing intelligence makes those entry point decisions for you, so you can plan around your in-home date with more confidence.


## Your next step


Choose your in-home date today, pick a template, connect your data, and schedule your first batch. The[holiday season](https://www.lob.com/ebooks/the-holiday-direct-mail-kit?utm_source=tldr&utm_medium=sponsored-content&utm_campaign=2026-community-marketing&utm_content=holiday-direct-mail-kit_header_holiday_marketing_timing&utm_term=2026-11-06) is still open, and your mail can be in homes in time to be part of it.
